theorems.statement: DeformationTheorem → (∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl P)), IsOpen U → ∀ (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (M : Set (Eucl P)) (θ : Eucl P → ℝ) (ξ : Eucl P → NVector (Eucl P) n), IsRectifiableTriple U n M θ ξ → (∀ ω : TestFormOn U n, T ω = tauAction n M θ ξ ω) → ∀ W : Set (Eucl P), IsOpen W → T.massOn W = ∫⁻ x in M ∩ W, ENNReal.ofReal (θ x) ∂(μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P))) → (∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl P)), IsOpen U → ∀ (T₁ T₂ S : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (a b : ℤ), IsIntegerMultiplicity T₁ → IsIntegerMultiplicity T₂ → (∀ ω, S ω = (a : ℝ) * T₁ ω + (b : ℝ) * T₂ ω) → IsIntegerMultiplicity S) → ∀ (P m : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl P)), IsOpen U → ∀ (K : Set (Eucl P)), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → ∃ C : ℝ≥0, ∀ (B : ℝ≥0∞), B ≠ ∞ → ∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → ∃ Qs : Set (GeometricCurrentOn U (m + 1)), Qs.Finite ∧ ∀ T : GeometricCurrentOn U (m + 1), IsIntegerMultiplicity T → IsIntegerMultiplicity T.boundary → T.support ⊆ K → T.mass + T.boundary.mass ≤ B → ∃ Q ∈ Qs, ∃ (R : GeometricCurrentOn U (m + 1 + 1)) (S : GeometricCurrentOn U (m + 1)), IsIntegerMultiplicity R ∧ IsIntegerMultiplicity S ∧ (∀ ω, T ω - Q ω = R.boundary ω + S ω) ∧ R.mass + S.mass ≤ C * ENNReal.ofReal ρ * B
